text.arabic_uthmani: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

words.gloss_range: be blessed, be magnified, overflow with blessing; locally a self-contained doxological perfect with no object and with the name phrase as explicit subject
words.root_gloss_range: settling, pooling, lasting blessing, and increase; locally the Form VI perfect selects self-contained divine abundance rather than a transitive act of blessing another object

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the nominative name noun that serves as the explicit subject of the opening verb
the bound name-of-your-Lord phrase that bears the blessing predicate

words.prose: {{ar:تَبَٰرَكَ}} ({{tr:tabāraka}}) opens the final ayah as a settled doxological perfect, not as a request, command, or developing action. Because the verb is objectless, the blessing is not aimed at one named recipient; it stands as overflowing abundance. The grammar then gives that abundance an explicit bearer: {{ar:ٱسْمُ}} ({{tr:ismu}}), more fully {{ar:ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:ismu rabbika}}), is the subject, so the close makes the Lord's name itself the locus of blessing. Compared with other creative or cosmic {{ar:تَبَٰرَكَ}} ({{tr:tabāraka}}) formulas (7:54; 25:61; 40:64; 43:85), this ending redirects the recognized doxology to the name phrase; after the final denial question in 55:77, the answer is not another argument but a declaration of inexhaustible blessing. Its expanded sound and written long vowel slow the launch before the subject arrives.

topics.headline: the name bears the blessing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the blessing is grammatically carried by the Lord's name rather than by an unstated divine pronoun.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes {{ar:ٱسْمُ}} ({{tr:ismu}}) the explicit subject of {{ar:تَبَٰرَكَ}} ({{tr:tabāraka}}), so the CRITICAL claim survives as local grammar rather than implication.

topics.headline: objectless abundance, not a directed blessing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb declares settled, self-contained abundance instead of narrating God blessing an outside object.
topics.reason: The root imagery of settling and increase is useful, but local Form VI intransitive grammar narrows it to self-contained doxological abundance.

topics.headline: completed formulaic praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the surah close with a stable perfect declaration rather than the open interrogative force of the refrain.
topics.reason: The distributional evidence and local parsing agree that the form is a marked perfect doxology used of God, not a freely varied tense or person choice.

topics.headline: known formula redirected
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that a formula often used after creative or cosmic displays is here assigned to the name phrase itself.
topics.reason: The parallels (7:54; 25:61; 40:64; 43:85) support formula recognition, while the local subject phrase keeps the payoff focused on the name rather than on an all-purpose creative act.

topics.headline: denial answered by blessing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse turn from the accused denial of favors in 55:77 to an abundance that denial cannot diminish.
topics.reason: The boundary rows align with the grammar: the final declarative verb changes the speech act from interrogation to praise.

topics.headline: wide opening cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening word stretch the final launch before the subject is named.
topics.reason: The phonetic and orthographic rows do not change the syntax, but they preserve a real recitational payoff at the ayah opening.

words.gloss_range: name, designation; locally the singular construct subject made definite through the following Lord noun
words.root_gloss_range: name/designation together with elevation imagery in the s-m-w family; locally the name sense is selected, while disputed marking and elevation associations remain secondary lexical pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the doxological verb for which the name is the subject
the genitive Lord noun that makes the construct name definite

words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْمُ}} ({{tr:ismu}}) is not a loose mention of a divine label; it is the nominative subject of {{ar:تَبَٰرَكَ}} ({{tr:tabāraka}}). Its construct link to {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) makes the name definite and Lord-bound, so the clause blesses the name of your Lord rather than an indefinite name. The noun form steadies naming as a subject instead of narrating an act of naming, while the s-m-w elevation field lets designation feel raised into distinctness. The possible marking derivation and naming-act pressure are real lexical background, but local grammar selects the name/designation sense. The nominative variant route for the following possessor title can make the name itself receive that title, while standard local case attaches it to the Lord. In recitation, liaison lets the blessing verb flow into the subject. The word also changes the 55:27 frame: what was attached there to the enduring face returns here as the blessed name, with name-of-your-Lord formulas elsewhere in view (56:74; 56:96).

topics.headline: designation is the subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the name itself performs the grammatical role that carries the blessing predicate.
topics.reason: The bundle marks {{ar:ٱسْمُ}} ({{tr:ismu}}) as nominative subject of {{ar:تَبَٰرَكَ}} ({{tr:tabāraka}}), preserving the CRITICAL claim directly.

topics.headline: Lord-bound definite name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the name as a single definite designation bound to the Lord, not as a generic label or a list of names.
topics.reason: The construct relation licenses possession and some naming-act pressure, but local noun syntax keeps the selected sense as the Lord-bound name.

topics.headline: raised designation, not sky sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the name sense carries elevation and distinct-marking pressure without turning into a reference to the heavens.
topics.reason: The s-m-w family and derivational dispute are relevant, but the local abstract noun and construct grammar select name/designation rather than a cosmic sky referent.

topics.headline: variant opens a name-modifier route
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that case variation can route the following title toward the name, even though the standard local case attaches it to the Lord.
topics.reason: The variant is valid apparatus for attachment pressure, but the standard alignment has genitive {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}) modifying {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}).

topics.headline: name replaces face in the return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the close return to the earlier divine-title frame while shifting from face in 55:27 to name in 55:78.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows have concrete parallels (55:27; 56:74; 56:96), and the local construct phrase supports the formulaic return.

topics.headline: sound fuses subject to verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the subject depend on the preceding blessing verb through liaison, not only through written syntax.
topics.reason: The sound row reinforces the same verb-subject dependency already established by grammar.

words.gloss_range: your Lord, master, owner, sustainer; locally a genitive singular Lord title with a second-person masculine singular possessive suffix
words.root_gloss_range: owning, governing, nurturing, and bringing to completion; locally the favor-catalog context foregrounds sustaining Lordship rather than abstract rule alone

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the construct head that governs the Lord noun
the genitive possessor adjective that attaches to the Lord in the standard reading
the honoring noun that completes the final title pair

words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) is genitive under {{ar:ٱسْمُ}} ({{tr:ismu}}), so Lordship specifies whose name bears the blessing. The attached singular suffix makes the close relational and directly addressed: after the dual challenge of the refrain, the ayah contracts to your Lord, and the singular construct binds the name to one Lord rather than divided lordships. The following {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}) agrees with this genitive Lord noun in the standard reading, so the majesty-and-honoring title belongs grammatically to the Lord rather than floating free. The root range adds more than ownership; in a surah filled with favors, {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) keeps sustaining and bringing-to-completion in view. Its sound also binds the construct chain before the title expands. The word ties the 55:27 title frame to 55:78 while k-r-m parallels in 82:6 and 96:3 show the same Lordship-and-honor field turning here into doxological praise.

topics.headline: Lord specifies the blessed name
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Lordship as the bridge from the blessed name into the final possessed-attribute title.
topics.reason: The local chain makes {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) both the genitive complement of {{ar:ٱسْمُ}} ({{tr:ismu}}) and the noun modified by {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}).

topics.headline: dual challenge contracts to singular address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the suffix itself marks the turn from the refrain's dual accused audience to a singular doxological relation.
topics.reason: The attachment and translation support rows both mark the suffix as singular, making the boundary shift a morphological payoff.

topics.headline: sustainer, not bare owner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Lord title carries nurturing and completion after the catalog of favors, not rule alone.
topics.reason: The broader root range is valid, but local context narrows it toward sustaining Lordship without excluding ownership and mastery.

topics.headline: singular construct excludes divided lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing name bound to one Lord of the addressed hearer rather than to plural or divided lordships.
topics.reason: The singular construct morphology directly supports the topic.

topics.headline: same root-pair becomes praise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Lordship plus k-r-m language can appear in rebuke or command elsewhere, but here it resolves as closing doxology.
topics.reason: The parallels (82:6; 96:3) are concrete and useful, while local syntax keeps the function doxological rather than interrogative or imperative.

topics.headline: Lord phrase anchors the bookends
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same Lord phrase linking the enduring face context in 55:27 with the blessed name context in 55:78.
topics.reason: The repeated phrase with the same title pair creates a same-surah frame from 55:27 to 55:78.

topics.headline: recited binding of name and Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the construct chain bind the name to the Lord before the title expands.
topics.reason: The phonetic row is modest but preserves a local recitation payoff for the construct chain.

words.gloss_range: possessor of, characterized by; locally the genitive five-noun adjective modifying your Lord and governing the two attribute nouns
words.root_gloss_range: possession, having, and characterization; locally a construct possessor that gathers majesty and honoring as one possessed title pair

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the nominative name noun that a variant nominative possessor can modify
the genitive Lord noun modified by the standard form
the first genitive attribute governed by the possessor noun
the coordinated second genitive attribute governed with the first
the nominative variant form that can route the attribute phrase to the name

words.prose: {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}) is the hinge of the final title. In the standard reading its genitive long-vowel form agrees with {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}), so the Lord is the possessor of {{ar:ٱلْجَلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-jalāli}}) and {{ar:ٱلْإِكْرَامِ}} ({{tr:al-ikrāmi}}). Because the word is construct, it cannot stand as a bare descriptor; it requires the attribute complement and gathers both qualities under one relational head as identity-bearing qualities rather than detachable ornaments. The nominative variant {{ar:ذُو}} ({{tr:dhū}}) makes a real alternative attachment route to {{ar:ٱسْمُ}} ({{tr:ismu}}), so the title's attachment is interpretively live, but local standard grammar keeps {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}) attached to the Lord. The long genitive sound opens the measured title cadence. The repeated possessor phrase returns from 55:27 to 55:78, making this ordinary possession word carry a rare surah-local title formula.

topics.headline: standard case attaches title to Lord
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that case decides whether the title characterizes the Lord or, by variant, the Lord's name.
topics.reason: The qiraat pressure survives, but standard {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}) is genitive and agrees with {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}); variant {{ar:ذُو}} ({{tr:dhū}}) supplies the name-attachment route.

topics.headline: one possessor governs both attributes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees majesty and honoring gathered as one possessed title field rather than as loose descriptors.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence confirms {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}) governs {{ar:ٱلْجَلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-jalāli}}) and the coordinated {{ar:ٱلْإِكْرَامِ}} ({{tr:al-ikrāmi}}).

topics.headline: possessed qualities define the possessor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title presents majesty and honoring as identity-bearing qualities, not incidental possessions.
topics.reason: The possessor construction supports characterization while local syntax supplies the governed attribute pair.

topics.headline: long vowel carries case
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the genitive case decision in the long-vowel five-noun form itself.
topics.reason: The form class makes case visible through {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}), so morphology directly supports the attachment reading.

topics.headline: possessor word carries the title return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the possessor phrase as the mechanism by which the rare 55:27 title returns at the close.
topics.reason: The exact title formula is local to 55:27 and 55:78, so the possessor noun has structural frame value here.

topics.headline: long vowel starts the title cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the attribute beat begin with the long genitive sound before the two attribute nouns unfold.
topics.reason: The phonetic payoff is local and modest, but it reinforces the marked title beat.

words.gloss_range: majesty, grandeur, awe-inducing greatness; locally the first definite genitive maṣdar possessed under the title head
words.root_gloss_range: greatness, being beyond measure, surrounding magnitude, and reverent magnification; locally awe-inducing divine majesty rather than mere size

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the possessor noun governing the majesty attribute
the coordinated honoring attribute that balances majesty

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجَلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-jalāli}}) is definite and genitive under {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}), so majesty is not an independent actor in the clause but a possessed, recognized attribute in the title. Its maṣdar form makes majesty a stable quality rather than a one-time description, and the root field presses toward awe-inducing greatness that exceeds measure, not mere size. The written and recited length gives the rare noun measured acoustic space matching the paired honoring noun. It also comes first in the pair, setting the pole of overwhelming grandeur that {{ar:ٱلْإِكْرَامِ}} ({{tr:al-ikrāmi}}) then balances with dignifying generosity. Because the supplied data gives this form only at 55:27 and 55:78, the word functions as a surah-local frame marker: the majesty attached to the enduring face in 55:27 returns attached to the blessed name at the close. The broader transcendence contrast in 43:82 remains nearby, but here majesty is named directly.

topics.headline: recognized possessed majesty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that majesty is a definite possessed attribute inside the title, not a free-standing predicate.
topics.reason: The local genitive maṣdar under {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}) confirms the possessed-attribute role.

topics.headline: majesty as overwhelming greatness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the first attribute as awe-inducing magnitude that calls for reverence, not as a neutral size word.
topics.reason: The root range supports grandeur and reverent response, while local title grammar narrows it to divine majesty.

topics.headline: majesty precedes honoring
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the title move from overwhelming grandeur into gracious honoring rather than ending with awe alone.
topics.reason: The local order and coordination place {{ar:ٱلْجَلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-jalāli}}) as the first pole of a balanced title pair.

topics.headline: rare majesty term returns
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the rare majesty noun tie 55:27's enduring face to 55:78's blessed name.
topics.reason: The occurrence profile marks the form as near-exclusive to the two Surah 55 title contexts.

topics.headline: named majesty beside transcendence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 55:78 names majesty directly where another divine-transcendence context denies false description (43:82).
topics.reason: The comparison is useful as contrast only; it does not override the local title construction.

topics.headline: matched abstract sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the rare majesty noun occupy a measured acoustic space that matches the paired honoring noun.
topics.reason: The long-vowel and maṣdar-shape rows preserve a local sound-and-form payoff without changing the lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: and; locally the one-letter proclitic coordinating the second attribute under the same possessor phrase

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the possessor noun whose scope contains both coordinated attributes
the first attribute coordinated by the particle
the second attribute joined to majesty under the same possessor
the attached conjunction plus second attribute as pronounced and written together

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does more than add a second word. It keeps {{ar:ٱلْإِكْرَامِ}} ({{tr:al-ikrāmi}}) inside the same genitive scope as {{ar:ٱلْجَلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-jalāli}}) under {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}), so majesty and honoring remain one governed title. At the same time, the conjunction prevents collapse: the two attributes stay distinct while functioning as an inseparable pair. It is the hinge from overwhelming grandeur into beneficent dignity without breaking the phrase. Its one-letter proclitic form in {{ar:وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ}} ({{tr:wa-l-ikrāmi}}) makes the hinge visually small but structurally decisive, and liaison carries the sound straight into the final noun.

topics.headline: same governance for both attributes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that honoring is governed with majesty under the same possessor, not appended as a separate clause.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes {{ar:ٱلْإِكْرَامِ}} ({{tr:al-ikrāmi}}) coordinated with {{ar:ٱلْجَلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-jalāli}}) inside the complement of {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}).

topics.headline: distinct attributes, one field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees majesty and honoring distinguished by coordination while presented as a single balanced divine-title field.
topics.reason: Simple coordination and combination both fit locally: the particle separates the nouns while joining them under one title.

topics.headline: hinge from awe to beneficence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final title move from overwhelming grandeur into beneficent dignity without breaking the phrase.
topics.reason: The particle's position between the two attribute nouns creates the local semantic pivot.

topics.headline: small form, tight join
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the coordination fused to the second attribute even though it changes the whole title structure.
topics.reason: The one-letter proclitic and liaison rows preserve a real formal payoff that reinforces tight coordination.

words.gloss_range: honoring, dignifying generosity, bestowal of honor; locally the second definite genitive Form IV maṣdar coordinated with majesty
words.root_gloss_range: nobility, preciousness, generosity, and honoring; locally the Form IV gerund foregrounds active bestowal of dignity rather than only intrinsic nobility

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the possessor noun under which honoring is governed
the majesty noun coordinated with the final honoring noun
the coordinated final attribute phrase

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْإِكْرَامِ}} ({{tr:al-ikrāmi}}) is genitive because {{ar:وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ}} ({{tr:wa-l-ikrāmi}}) coordinates it with {{ar:ٱلْجَلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-jalāli}}) under {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}). The definite maṣdar makes honoring a stable possessed attribute, not a one-time favor, and the Form IV shape gives it active force: dignifying generosity, making another honored, rather than merely being noble. Because it follows majesty and is the surah's final word, the close does not end on awe alone; it lands on bestowed dignity. Its rarity and recurrence at 55:27 make the act noun part of the same title frame, while wider k-r-m links with Lordship and honoring (17:70; 22:18; 82:6; 96:3) show the field here concentrated into the nominalized closing seal. The matched genitive cadence makes the final word audible as the second half of a balanced title.

topics.headline: second attribute under the same possessor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that honoring has the same possessed-quality role as majesty rather than being a loose appended gloss.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence coordinates {{ar:ٱلْإِكْرَامِ}} ({{tr:al-ikrāmi}}) with {{ar:ٱلْجَلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-jalāli}}) under {{ar:ذِى}} ({{tr:dhī}}).

topics.headline: honoring as bestowed dignity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word as active dignifying generosity, not merely a generic adjective of nobility.
topics.reason: The k-r-m range includes nobility and generosity, but the local Form IV maṣdar narrows the payoff to caused or bestowed honoring.

topics.headline: stable title attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final noun stabilizes honoring as a title attribute rather than narrating a single act.
topics.reason: The singular definite maṣdar mirrors the majesty noun and forms a stable coordinate title-member.

topics.headline: surah lands on bestowed dignity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the final aftertaste as active honoring after majesty, not grandeur by itself.
topics.reason: The final-word position, rare form, and order after {{ar:ٱلْجَلَٰلِ}} ({{tr:al-jalāli}}) make the closing payoff specific.

topics.headline: rare act noun returns from 55:27
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the act of honoring as a signature of the two Surah 55 title contexts.
topics.reason: The supplied occurrence data gives the gerund in the paired 55:27 and 55:78 title contexts.

topics.headline: honoring traced to the divine title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees granted dignity in other passages traced back here to the Lord as possessor of honoring.
topics.reason: The parallels (17:70; 22:18; 82:6; 96:3) are useful as network evidence, while the local form remains the final nominalized title attribute.

topics.headline: parallel form and audible landing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final attribute as the matched second half of a balanced title seal.
topics.reason: Matching definiteness, genitive cadence, maṣdar form, and coordination support the balanced title reading.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicate at word 1 governs the Lord's Name at words 2-3 and culminates in honoring at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: Blessing is fixed yet increasing good located in a communicative Name; lordship matures that good and honoring carries it outward as noble generosity.

activation_trace.role: Fixed, increasing good gives the predicate both durability and generative force.
Naming as designation and signification locates that good in a communicative Name.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the ongoing process by which the good matures.
Praiseworthy nobility and generosity make honoring both intrinsic excellence and outward giving.

changed_reading.before: A closing declaration that the Lord's name is blessed and honored.
changed_reading.after: The Name is the disclosed site where enduring good is continually matured into generous benefit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 1-3 place settling blessing beside a Name whose root inventory also carries elevation and visibility.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two opposed vectors coexist: good settles and becomes stable while the Name rises into public visibility; sovereign lordship and conferred value make that visible Name an orienting center.

activation_trace.role: Kneeling and settling give blessing a downward motion into stable emplacement.
Rising high gives the Name the counter-motion of elevation.
A raised outline visible from afar turns elevation into public recognizability.
Sovereignty makes the visible Name a center of orientation rather than mere prominence.
Dearness and high value explain why attention is drawn toward that center.

changed_reading.before: Blessed means only exalted, and the Name is only a title.
changed_reading.after: Good settles into reality while the Name rises into view, joining stable presence to visible orientation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The utterance combines persistent blessing at word 1, naming at word 2, abiding lordship at word 3, and a formula-like honoring at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: The line can perform what it says: its speaker holds fast to the Name, sustains the relation, and voices willing honor rather than merely reporting an attribute.

activation_trace.role: Holding fast and pressing on supplies sustained adherence rather than static possession.
The act of naming gives the utterance its performative object.
Abiding and remaining make the named relation durable.
A formula of willing honor lets the closing clause function as voiced assent.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes blessedness from a distance.
changed_reading.after: Reciting the verse is itself an act of adhering to the Name and answering it with willing honor.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus verse's settling/rising polarity becomes a surah-wide vertical circuit: creatures lower themselves, the sky is raised, measure is placed, and blessing settles while the Name rises.

activation_trace.role: Settling in place anchors the downward pole of the focus mechanism.
Rising high anchors the upward pole in the Name.
Lowering and humility turn the star or stemless growth and tree into active downward participants.
Raising the sky supplies the explicit upward motion that echoes the Name's elevation.
Putting something in a lower or appointed place makes descent ordered emplacement rather than loss of rank.

structural_cues: 55:6 gives a dual prostration to the star or stemless growth and the tree.
55:7 raises the sky and places the balance; 55:10 likewise places the earth for creatures.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lowering, raising, and appointed placement; I infer one coordinated vertical circuit whose poles meet in 55:78. A live alternative is that these remain separate cosmic acts with no lexical feedback into the closing line.

changed_reading.before: The closing blessing moves only upward as exaltation.
changed_reading.after: The line coordinates two motions: blessing establishes itself below while the Name rises above, making cosmic humility and elevation mutually sustaining.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching, disclosure, calculation, and balance activate the non-dominant mark branch behind the focus Name: the Name becomes a legible signature by which created order is recognized and calibrated.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark turns the Name from a label into a readable signature.
Designation and signification keep the marked-signature reading anchored in naming.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic act by which the signature becomes readable.
Uncovering meaning through speech or sign gives the signature communicative content.
Counting and calculation make cosmic regularity one readable register of the Name.
The balance of justice extends legibility from cosmic measure into ethical calibration.

structural_cues: 55:2-4 sequences teaching revelation, creating the human, and teaching articulation.
55:5-9 moves from celestial calculation to a placed balance and commands against corrupting measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies learning, sign-mediated disclosure, calculation, and just measure; I infer that their common legibility converges on the focus Name as signature. The ordinary designation sense remains fully live, and the mark reading depends on a non-dominant mapped root.

changed_reading.before: The Name is an elevated verbal designation.
changed_reading.after: The Name is also the legible signature of measured creation and justice, teaching the reader how to recognize and calibrate what the surah displays.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal asking and recurring divine activity turn lordship from a title into continuous responsive maintenance; fixed growing good is replenished through acts of repair and completion.

activation_trace.role: Nurture, repair, and completion define lordship as active maintenance.
Fixed yet growing good is the maintained result, not a static stock.
Asking and requesting supply the field of needs to which governance responds.
A recurring span of time makes maintenance continuous rather than exceptional.
Repairing and doing work well gives the recurring affair a constructive direction.

structural_cues: 55:29 places every being in the heavens and earth in a posture of asking, then says that He is in an affair every day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal requests, recurring time, and constructive activity; I infer the arrow request to ongoing maintenance to renewed good. A live alternative is that the daily affair varies independently of those requests rather than answering them.

changed_reading.before: Lordship names a settled rank and blessing a completed endowment.
changed_reading.after: Lordship continually answers creaturely need by repairing and completing, so the blessed good remains stable precisely through ceaseless renewal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-parallel at 55:26-27 distinguishes finite carriers from an abiding divine self-presence; the final Name becomes the addressable and recitable mode by which that abiding presence remains active for the hearer.

activation_trace.role: Designation and signification make the Name available to speech after finite visible bearers disappear.
Fixed, growing good prevents recitable persistence from becoming a merely inert remainder.
Cessation after prior continuance establishes the finitude against which the ending is heard.
Enduring continuation supplies the counter-state that the final blessing recalls.
Face as self or essence keeps what abides from being reduced to a surviving verbal token.

structural_cues: 55:27 and 55:78 repeat the same branchless ج ل ل occurrence at word 5 and the same ر ب ب / ك ر م frame; only وجه versus اسم and ذو versus ذي change.
55:26 immediately precedes the abiding-Face line with the disappearance of everyone upon the earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disappearance, an abiding Face-as-self, and a final Name in a nearly identical frame; I infer that the recitable Name mediates relation to abiding presence. The live alternative is formal ring closure with no ontological distinction or mediation between Face and Name.

changed_reading.before: The ending simply repeats the praise of 55:27 with a synonym.
changed_reading.after: After finite forms vanish, the abiding self-presence is not collapsed into the Name, yet the Name remains its blessed, recitable interface for the hearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The basin and fertile-bounty branches in the focus become an ecology: good is retained, released as flowing or gushing water, and converted into green abundance without exhausting its source.

activation_trace.role: Water held in a basin supplies retention and source stability.
Fixed growing good converts retained supply into increase rather than stagnation.
Rain-bearing cloud and fertile growth make honoring materially productive.
Flowing and coursing provide the release path from retained source to garden.
A spring as a source of running water localizes the point of emergence.
Abundant gushing intensifies circulation into surplus.
Verdure, ease, and abundant living show the experiential yield of the water cycle.

structural_cues: The surah moves from earth, fruit, grain, and fragrance through two seas to flowing and gushing springs, gardens, and green furnishings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a held-water focus branch and contextual source, flow, gush, and verdure; I supply the causal arrow retention to circulation to growth. These images could instead remain separate gifts with no single hydrological mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Blessing is a static quantity of good possessed by the Name.
changed_reading.after: Blessing is source architecture: it holds without hoarding, releases without depletion, and turns circulation into fertile honoring.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated challenge about the Lord's benefits trains a response; immediately after its final occurrence, the focus line performs durable assent by holding fast to the Name and voicing willing honor.

activation_trace.role: Holding fast makes the final acclamation a sustained answer rather than a momentary exclamation.
A formula of willing honor gives the answer an audible form of assent.
Benefits and favors are the repeated objects that call for acknowledgment.
The non-dominant image of following and succession activates the refrain as a chain whose last link leads into 55:78.
Abiding and continuance make the refrain's Lord the stable relation carried through every recurrence.
Contradiction or denial supplies the challenged response that the final acclamation reverses.

structural_cues: The same dual-address question occurs thirty-one times, with its final occurrence at 55:77 immediately before the focus verse.
The refrain's ربكما shifts to the focus verse's singular ربك.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated questions, benefits, denial, and immediate adjacency; I infer that 55:78 functions as the cultivated answer and not only narrator doxology. The narrator-only reading remains possible, and the succession branch is explicitly a non-dominant activation.

changed_reading.before: The refrain ends and an independent praise formula closes the surah.
changed_reading.after: The final praise is the response the refrain has been eliciting: persistent acknowledgment of the Name after repeated opportunities to deny.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit reciprocity of beneficence activates honoring as a gift that generates an answering gift: received good elicits praise and ethical beneficence without reducing grace to commercial exchange.

activation_trace.role: A gift offered with recompense in view supplies the provocative reciprocal structure.
Generosity and noble forbearance prevent reciprocity from collapsing into a market transaction.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the explicit return relation.
Beneficent action appears on both sides of the return relation, making likeness ethical rather than monetary.

structural_cues: 55:60 asks whether the recompense of beneficence is anything but beneficence, placing the same noun on both sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit act-for-act return and a focus gift branch; I infer that the final acclamation can be the receiver's non-equivalent answering gift. Alternatively, 55:60 may describe divine reward alone, so the model must not imply that divine generosity needs payment.

changed_reading.before: Honoring is a one-way attribute or gift descending from the Lord.
changed_reading.after: Honoring also generates a return path: generosity elicits praise and beneficence, while remaining prior to and greater than its answer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Meeting, relation-between, and pairing organize the surah's dual worlds; the final shift from dual to singular address gathers those pairs into an encounter in which each hearer faces the one Lord through the one Name.

activation_trace.role: Single sovereignty provides the common center toward which paired domains and addressees turn.
One designation gives the many pairings a shared point of recognition without erasing their differences.
A relation standing between endpoints lets distinction and connection coexist.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies encounter without forced merger.
A counterpart joined to its counterpart generalizes paired organization into the garden inventory.

structural_cues: The surah repeatedly uses dual forms for two addressees, two easts and wests, two seas, two gardens, two springs, and paired fruits.
After repeated ربكما, 55:78 closes with singular ربك.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies persistent dual structures, paired-but-bounded encounter, and a final pronoun shift; I infer that the singular address individualizes each hearer's answer while retaining both addressees. The shift may instead be a conventional address to the Prophet or reciter with no gathering function.

changed_reading.before: The singular second person is an incidental grammatical change at the close.
changed_reading.after: The one Name gathers a world of coexisting pairs into singular encounter: each member is addressed without the pair being collapsed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it leans on the non-dominant س م م mapping for اسم and peripheral basin, lid, and tied-vessel senses. It remains anchored in focus words 1, 2, and 6 and is activated by the surah's barrier, passage, and authority sequence. Render it only as an exploratory spatial analogy, never as a lexical translation of اسم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The held-basin branch of word 1, narrow-opening split branch of word 2, and vessel-cover branch of word 6 can form one bounded-access mechanism.

activation_trace.role: A basin holding water supplies a bounded store whose benefit depends on containment.
A narrow aperture from the non-dominant split root supplies controlled access through the Name.
A plate covering a vessel supplies preservation at the container's upper boundary.
Transgressing a limit identifies the failure that the productive boundary prevents.
Passing cleanly to the other side supplies the traversal whose conditions are at issue.
Compelling warrant makes passage authorized rather than boundary-destroying.
Tying a vessel closed reinforces the packet's recurrent containment architecture.

changed_reading.before: The Name merely labels an unlimited abundance.
changed_reading.after: The Name can be imagined as the warranted aperture of held abundance: boundaries preserve the good and permit ordered access rather than suppressing flow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the necklace sense of ك ر م is peripheral and the move from listed materials to literary composition is reader-supplied. It remains anchored in focus word 6 and in packet images of pearl, coral, and precious patterned fabric. Render it as a compositional analogy for how the surah arranges images, not as the denotation of إكرام.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The necklace branch of honoring at word 6 can make the final attribute a figure for the surah's assembled precious materials.

activation_trace.role: A necklace of strung pieces supplies the compositional frame for assembled honor.
The Name gives the assembled images a named center of reference.
The pearl supplies one literal precious unit available for stringing.
Coral or bead supplies a second materially distinct unit beside pearl.
The coral image recurs in comparison, allowing one material to bind distant garden scenes.
Precious patterned carpets extend assembled honor from beads into woven surface.

changed_reading.before: Honoring is an abstract quality appended at the end.
changed_reading.after: Honoring becomes, exploratorily, the act of stringing the surah's pearls, coral, colors, and textures around the Name as one composed adornment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a form-distant branch of ك ذ ب about milk failing to remain rather than the ordinary denial branch. It stays anchored to the final refrain at 55:77 and to the focus branches of persistent, growing good. Render it only as a secondary material echo beneath propositional denial, which remains primary.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus predicate's growing-good and persistence branches immediately follow the final denial question and can answer a contextual image of yield that fails to last.

activation_trace.role: Fixed, increasing good supplies the durable yield asserted by the ending.
Persistence and pressing on oppose interruption or failure to continue.
Benefits identify what is received and therefore what could fail to be acknowledged or carried forward.
Abiding lordship supplies the durable source against which failed yield is measured.
Milk disappearing and not lasting activates denial as a failure of received good to continue yielding.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only saying that the benefits are false.
changed_reading.after: Beneath that primary sense, denial can also picture received good failing to endure or yield; the final blessing counters it with inexhaustible, persistent increase.

strongest_changes: The near-parallel with 55:26-27 turns the Name into a recitable interface with abiding presence after finite forms disappear.
55:29 turns lordship and blessing into continuous responsive maintenance rather than static rank and stored good.
Teaching, articulation, calculation, and balance make the Name a legible signature of cosmic and ethical measure.
The thirty-onefold refrain makes 55:78 a cultivated answer of durable assent, while the singular address individualizes that answer.
Water, spring, flow, gush, fertility, and verdure make blessing a retention-and-circulation ecology.
summary.what_was_special: The closing line supports several live mechanisms at once: settling and rising, naming and marking, persistence and renewal, singular address amid paired worlds, and material containment that enables rather than blocks abundance. Non-dominant mapped roots opened real but explicitly contained readings instead of being collapsed into the dominant target.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet provides no branch inventory for ج ل ل, so its repeated position can support structure but not a branch-specific mechanism.
The Name/Face relation may be theological mediation, rhetorical ring closure, or both; the packet does not force one ontology.
The mark, aperture, succession, necklace, gift-for-return, and failed-yield activations rely on split or peripheral branches and must remain exploratory.
Causal arrows such as request to maintenance and retention to circulation are abductive reader constructions; the packet supplies their elements but not the direction.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Blessing as fixed, growing good.** `ب ر ك/B004` gives divine good that remains fixed while increasing; `ر ب ب/B002` gives stage-by-stage nurture. The entire packet supplies the growth sequence from measured cosmos through produce to gardens. I infer that the divine name is the stable source from which those increases proceed. The ayah reads as causal closure, not a detached doxology.
2. **Settling that generates rather than stagnates.** `ب ر ك/B001` gives settling firmly in place, while `ب ر ك/B004` adds growth. Their coexistence resolves the surah's motion/boundary tension: what is truly settled can continuously give without fading. The name reads as stable generativity opposed to 55:26's universal fading.
3. **Majesty and generosity returned to the name.** The exact pair from 55:27 recurs after judgment and gardens. I infer that majesty governs limits and generosity fills the bounded spaces with good. The ayah preserves both readings rather than merging severity and beneficence into a compromise.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: As the final ayah, it has no later ayah to activate a new relation. Its surprise is retrospective in the opposite direction: it gathers 55:27's remaining face, 55:29's ongoing affairs, and all later garden growth into the single `ب ر ك/B004` image of good that is both fixed and increasing.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **`ب ر ك` `B004` — “fixed, growing good,” `س م و` `B005` — “name as raised designation,” `ر ب ب` `B001` — “lordship,” `ج ل ل` `B001` — “majesty,” and `ك ر م` `B001` — “nobility and generosity.”** Structural cue: the blessing verb governs `ٱسْمُ`, which is linked through `رَبِّكَ` to the paired attributes already used in 55:27; the final refrain immediately precedes it. Assigned role: fixed growing good characterizes the raised designation through which lordship, majesty, and generosity are acknowledged together. Packet evidence is the genitive chain, branch images, and terminal placement. Inference: the many finite favors culminate in durable source-recognition carried by the Lord-name. Reading change: the close does not merely add praise; it condenses the surah’s provision-and-authority mechanism into an enduring designation.

baseline.text: Yücelik ve ikram sahibi Rabbinin adı kutludur

findings.text: Kutluluk, sabit kaldığı hâlde artan iyilik anlamıyla bütün ölçülü yaratılış ve bahçe bereketinin kalıcı kaynağını adlandırır.
Yerleşip sabitlenme ile büyümenin birleşmesi, gerçek kalıcılığın durgunluk değil, tükenmeden üretme olduğunu gösterir.
İsim, Rabliği, yüceliği ve ikramı taşıyan yükseltilmiş bir tanıma işareti olarak bütün sonlu nimetleri kaynağına bağlar.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A nearer or lower garden tier is intensified through dark vegetal density, forceful water, and diverse fruit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Darkness can mark danger or an overwhelming crowd, but here it is converted into the visual index of water-rich growth; retained pools and forceful spray explain how that density is sustained.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Gushing Sources and Retained Water
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Springs force water outward, scatter droplets, leave traces, and feed stable retaining basins.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: spring or visible source `quranic:root_001069:B006/m01`; opening in a waterskin `quranic:root_001069:B007/m01`; persistent stain or splash `quranic:root_001514:B001/m01`; abundant surging water `quranic:root_001514:B002/m01`; dispersed spray `quranic:root_001514:B003/m01`; water retained in a basin `quranic:root_000109:B003/m01`; fixed and increasing good `quranic:root_000109:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The source is imagined as an opening under pressure: water surges, sprays, and marks what it touches. The stable basin and fixed blessing complete the mechanism by converting forceful emission into retained, renewable supply.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P5 Stable Blessing and the Exalted Name
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Beneficence is fixed, renewed, and publicly marked by the name of an exalted owner characterized by majesty and generosity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Blessing joins stability to growth, water retention, persistence in work, rain, and yield; the name operates as both identifying sign and circulating reputation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fixed Good that Continues to Yield
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Good settles into a place, persists through repeated work, retains resources, and continues to produce growth and provision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: settling firmly in a place `quranic:root_000109:B001/m01`; retained basin water `quranic:root_000109:B003/m01`; fixed and increasing good `quranic:root_000109:B004/m01`; persistent effort `quranic:root_000109:B006/m01`; milk yielded while settled `quranic:root_000109:B007/m01`; nurture and completion `quranic:root_000532:B002/m01`; lasting residence `quranic:root_000532:B007/m01`; layered rain cloud `quranic:root_000532:B008/m01`; abundant water `quranic:root_000532:B013/m01`; fertile rain and soil `quranic:root_001294:B002/m01`; grapevine and fruit `quranic:root_001294:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Blessing is a state that stays and a process that keeps yielding. Stable residence, stored water, persistent labor, rain, milk, and fruit assemble a resource cycle in which constancy is proven by renewed provision.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P5 Stable Blessing and the Exalted Name
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Beneficence is fixed, renewed, and publicly marked by the name of an exalted owner characterized by majesty and generosity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Blessing joins stability to growth, water retention, persistence in work, rain, and yield; the name operates as both identifying sign and circulating reputation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Name, Renown, Majesty, and Honor
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A name identifies and elevates its bearer, circulates as good renown, and gathers the social predicates of majesty, covering presence, honor, and preciousness.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: name and designation `quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`; elevated rank `quranic:root_000745:B001/m01`; circulating good renown `quranic:root_000745:B008/m01`; sovereign owner `quranic:root_000532:B001/m01`; majesty and greatness `quranic:root_000255:B001/m01`; encompassing cover `quranic:root_000255:B005/m01`; inscribed book or scroll `quranic:root_000255:B006/m01`; honor and generosity `quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`; necklace and ordered ornament `quranic:root_001294:B003/m01`; precious person or thing `quranic:root_001294:B010/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The name is an identifying mark that also raises and circulates reputation. Majesty gives it scale, encompassing cover gives it presence, and honor gives it the social action of generosity; inscription and ornament materialize how such a name is preserved and displayed.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi devenin çökmesi, hayvanın göğsünü yere bırakması, bir şeyin bir yerde sabit kalması, deve topluluğunun çökmüş halde bulunması, deve çökeği ve aynı kökten kalıp olarak yerleşip durma anlamını birlikte verir. Geçici bir inişten çok yer tutma ve kalma çekirdeği öne çıkar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal göğüs parçasını, su havuzunu veya hayır artışı anlamını değil, çökme ve yerinde sabitlenme eylemini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bare kapsam, anlamın kalıp bir söz dizimine bağlı olmadan çökme ve yerinde durma çekirdeğiyle tanımlanmasını gerektirir.

concept_map.definition: Bir devenin ya da benzeri bir varlığın yere çökerek orada sabitlenmesi; buradan genel olarak bir şeyin bulunduğu yerde yerleşip kalması.

facets.statement: Deve veya dişi deve yere çöker ve o konumda kalır.
Aynı çekirdek, herhangi bir şeyin bulunduğu yerde sabit durmasına genişler.
Çökmüş develer topluluğu, develerin çöktüğü yer ve yerleşip durma kalıbı bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dalı devenin çökmesi ve orada kalması üzerinden kurar; bazı ifadeler bunu bütün sabit durma ve yerleşme durumlarına geneller. Deve göğsü, havuz ve hayır artışı anlamları bu dalda ayrı anlam alanları olarak tutulmaz.

concept_gloss.applicability: Devenin çökmesi ve bundan türeyen yerleşip sabit kalma çekirdeğini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Çökme eylemini ve sonrasındaki yerinde kalmayı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvanın yere inip göğsünü yere yaklaştırdığı somut bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvan eylemini ve yere yerleşme sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Hayvan dışındaki varlıklar için genel yerleşme ve kalma bağlamlarında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sabitlenme ve kalma yönünü korur.
Kök ailesiyle tarihsel bağı çağrıştırır.
error_profile.loses: Çökme ve yerinde sabitlenme eylemini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Hayır, artış ve bolluk anlamı ekler.
error_profile.collision: Aynı kökteki hayır artışı dalıyla karışır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi suyun içinde kaldığı çukur, havuz benzeri yapı, su tutma yeri ve örülüp sıvanmış su haznelerini aynı dalda toplar. Gerekçe suyun orada durmasıdır, fakat anlam artık çökme eylemi değil suyu tutan yer adıdır.

Bir kişi ya da şey için bu hayrı istemek iyi dilek eylemi olarak kullanılır.
Bir şeyden iyi sonuç umarak ona yönelme kullanımı, hayrın onda bulunduğu kabulüne bağlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi dalın çekirdeğini hem somut yükselme hem de kişinin değerinin ve anılma düzeyinin yükselmesi olarak açıkça kurar. Bakışın yukarı yönelmesi bu çekirdeğin özel bir gerçekleşmesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel yükselmeyi kapsar; gök, ad, av ve yarışma dallarının kalıplaşmış anlamlarını kendi içine almaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel yükselme çekirdeği ile bakış, toplumsal konum ve gururlu duruşa bağlı özel kullanımlar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin fiziksel olarak yukarı çıkması veya bir kişinin toplumsal değerinin ve anılma düzeyinin yükselmesidir. Bakışın yukarı kaldırılması bu hareketin özel bir uygulamasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey bulunduğu düzeyden yukarı çıkar veya yüksek duruma gelir.
Bir kişinin değeri, saygınlığı ya da toplumdaki yeri yükselir.
Bakış bir şeye doğru yukarı kaldırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yükselmeyi dalın ortak çekirdeği sayar; bunu fiziksel yükselişe, bakışın kaldırılmasına ve değerli kişinin toplumdaki yerinin yükselmesine uygular.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın somut yükselme çekirdeğini ve kişinin değer ya da saygınlık bakımından yükselmesini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yukarı çıkma ile toplumsal değer artışını aynı yükselme ekseninde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin fiziksel olarak daha yüksek bir düzeye çıkmasını anlatan genel bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Fiziksel yukarı çıkma hareketini doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin toplumdaki değerinin veya konumunun yükseldiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin toplumsal değer bakımından yükselmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bakışın daha yüksekteki bir şeye yöneltildiği özel bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bakışın yukarı doğru kaldırılması işlemini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: toplumdaki yeri ve değeri yükselmiş olmak

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir şeyin yükselmesi ve yüksek duruma gelmesi yönündeki aynı genel çekirdeği anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kanıtta çekirdek kapsamı ayıran bir koşul görünmez; bakış, toplumsal değer ve dağın en yüksek yeriyle ilgili bağımlı kullanımlar bu genel yükselme eşdeğerliğini bozmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalı kişinin değer kazanmasını ve bakışın yukarı yönelmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyi kaldırma eylemini ve uzunluk gibi ek yüksek görünüşleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yükseklik kazanma ve yukarı yönelme alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında temel işlem öznenin yükselmesidir; komşuda bunun yanında bir nesneyi yükseltme ve başka yüksek görünüşler de çekirdeğe girer.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda yükselme, uzaktan görünür hale gelme koşulu olmadan da gerçekleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dalda yüksek bir görünüşün uzaktan belirmesi ve seçilmesi zorunludur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da yükseklik kazanmış bir şey bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı genel yükselme sürecini anlatır; komşu dal ise yükselen şeyin uzaktan görünür ve seçilebilir bir görünüş oluşturmasını anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; yalnız dalın genel yükselme sınırını en açık biçimde gösteren üç karşılaştırma yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه سمو الشيء وعلوه، وارتفاع البصر، وعلو الحسيب والشريف، ورفعة الذكر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه استعمال السماء للسقف أو المطر، ولا باب الاسم إلا من جهة اشتقاقه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل يدل على العلو؛ سموت إذا علوت (maqayis)؛ سما الشيء يسمو سموا أي ارتفع (ayn)؛ السمو الارتفاع والعلو (sihah)؛ سما الشيء يسمو سموا وهو ارتفاعه، ويقال للحسيب والشريف قد سما (tahdhib)؛ أصله من السمو وهو الذي به رفع ذكر المسمى (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi yalnız yükselmeyi değil, yükselen şeyin uzaktan belirip seçilebilir hale gelmesini de şart koşar. Ayın ince yayının ufuk üstündeki görünüşü bu çekirdeğin belirtilmiş örneğidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, görünür bir yüksek gövde ya da çizgi gerektirir; görünmeden gerçekleşen genel yükselme bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Uzaktan belirme çekirdeği, belirli görünme kalıpları ve ayın ufuk üstündeki görünüşüyle birlikte fakat ayrı kapsamlarla verilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ya da kişinin yükselerek uzaktan görünür ve seçilebilir hale gelmesi, yahut bir şeyin yüksekte beliren gövdesi veya çizgisidir. Ayın ince yayının ufuk üstünde belirmesi bunun özel bir örneğidir.

facets.statement: Bir şey yükselir ve uzaktan bakıldığında görünür, ayırt edilir hale gelir.
Bir şeyin yüksekte görünen gövdesi, dış çizgisi ya da belirgin yanı anlatılır.
Ayın ince yayı ufuktan biraz yükseldiğinde görünen biçimiyle örneklenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yükselen bir şeyin uzaktan belirip seçilmesini ve yüksekte görünen gövde ya da çizgisini ortak anlam olarak verir; ayın ufuktan yükselen görünüşünü örnekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yükselme, görünür olma ve uzaktan seçilebilme koşullarını birlikte taşıyan bütün dal için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yükseklik ile uzaktan görünür hale gelme bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi ya da nesne yükselerek uzaktan seçilebilir hale geldiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yükselme ile uzaktan görünme aşamalarını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin yüksek ve görünür gövdesi ya da dış çizgisi kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Görünür yüksek gövde veya çizgi anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ayın ince yayının ufkun üzerine çıkıp görünür hale geldiği özel bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ayın ufuktan yükselerek beliren görünüşünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı görünürlüğü yükselmenin sonucu olarak sınırlar; komşu dalın görünen gövde kavramı yükselme gerektirmeden daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal görülen kişinin, eşyanın veya gece seçilen nesnenin genel siluetini kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalının silueti yüksek ve beliren bir siluettir; komşu dal ise yüksekliğe bağlı olmayan genel görünür gövdeyi anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da daha önce seçilmeyen bir şey görünür hale gelir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal genel ortaya çıkışı anlatırken odak dalı bu görünürlüğü yükselmiş ve uzaktan seçilen bir gövdeyle sınırlar.

branches.source_phrase_ar: سما لي شخص ارتفع حتى استثبته؛ سماوة الهلال وكل شيء شخصه (maqayis)؛ سما لي شيء؛ سماوة الهلال شخصه إذا ارتفع عن الأفق شيئا (ayn)؛ سما لي شخص؛ سماوة كل شيء شخصه (sihah)؛ سما لي شيء؛ سماوته أي شخصه؛ سماوة الهلال شخصه (tahdhib)؛ السماوة الشخص العالي؛ وسما لي شخص (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi genel yükselmeyi değil, erkek devenin dişi deve sürüsünün üzerine atılıp aralarına girdiği belirli hareketi anlatır. Geçici dal tanımı bu katılımcıları ve hareket aşamalarını doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız erkek deve ile dişi deve sürüsünü içeren bu yapıya bağlıdır; genel yükselme ya da yarışma anlamına genişletilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız erkek devenin dişi deve sürüsüne yönelik hareketini bildiren belirtilmiş söz yapısıyla sınırlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi üstte bulunup örten şey çekirdeğini gök ve tavanla verir; bulut, yağmur, bitki, atın sırtı ve her şeyin üst yanı kullanımlarını da açıkça ekler. Dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve ona bağlı aktarmaları doğru ayırmaya elverişlidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üstte olma ve örtme çekirdeği önde tutulur; bulut, yağmur, bitki ve at sırtı kullanımları genel yükselme anlamına dönüştürülmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Gök ve üst örtü çekirdeği ile bulut, yağmur, bitki, at sırtı ve genel üst yan kullanımları ayrı kapsamlarla korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin üzerinde bulunan ve onu örten gök, tavan ya da genel üst yandır. Bu ad buluta, yukarıdan gelen yağmura, yağmurla çıkan veya yükselen bitkiye ve atın sırtına da aktarılır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin üzerinde yükselen ve onu örten gök, tavan veya üst yan anlatılır.
Üstte bulunan ve örten bulut aynı adla anılır.
Yukarıdaki kaynağından gelen yağmur aynı adla anılır.
Yağmurdan çıkan veya yerden yükselen bitkiye aynı ad aktarılır.
Atın sırtı ve genel olarak bir şeyin en üst yanı bu yüksek üst yüzey kapsamında adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gök, tavan ve üst yan anlamlarını yüksekte bulunup örtme çekirdeğinde birleştirir; bulut, yağmur, bitki ve at sırtı kullanımlarını buna bağlı uzantılar olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi adı bir şeyi tanıtan gösterge olarak tanımlar; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve aynı adı ya da niteliği hak eden denklik anlamlarını açıkça bağlar. Adın anılmayı yükselttiğine ilişkin açıklama anlamın tarihsel gerekçesi olarak tutulur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal dilsel adlandırma ve adla kurulan denklikle sınırlıdır; gök ya da fiziksel yükselme anlamı yalnız açıklayıcı köken bağıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ad çekirdeği; ad verme, ad edinme, adaşlık ve ad ya da nitelik bakımından denklik bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrılarak tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi tanıtan ad, bu adı verme veya edinme ve başka biriyle aynı adı taşıma ilişkisidir. Ayrıca aynı adı ya da niteliği hak edecek ölçüde denk olmayı anlatır; kaynaklar adlandırmayı anılmayı yükseltme düşüncesiyle açıklar.

facets.statement: Ad, bir varlığı tanıtan ve ondan söz etmeyi sağlayan söz veya anlamdır.
Birine ad verilir veya kişi kendisi için bir ad edinir ve o adla çağrılır.
İki kişi aynı adı taşıdığında birbirinin adaşı olur.
Bir kişi, aynı adı veya niteliği hak edecek ölçüde başkasının dengi sayılır.
Kaynaklar adın kökenini, adı verilen şeyin anılmasını yükseltmesi ve onu belirgin kılmasıyla açıklar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar adı bir varlığı tanıtan unsur sayar; ad verme, ad edinme, aynı adı taşıma ve ada ya da niteliğe layık denklik anlamlarını birleştirir. Adın anılmayı yükselttiği yönündeki köken açıklamasını da paylaşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi çekirdeği bir topluluğun ıssız arazilere av için çıkması olarak verir; avcı adı, av hayvanını arama ve avcının sıcak zeminde beklerken giydiği çorap da aynı av alanına bağlıdır. Dal çerçevesi bu bağı korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Av için araziye çıkma çekirdeği; avcı, av hayvanını arama ve avcı çorabı bildiren özel biçimlerden ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir topluluğun avlanmak için kır ve çöl gibi ıssız arazilere çıkmasıdır. Avcılar, av hayvanını arama ve avcının sıcak zeminde beklerken giydiği koruyucu çorap bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir topluluk avlanmak amacıyla kır veya çöl gibi ıssız araziye çıkar.
Bu amaçla araziye çıkan kişiler avcı adıyla anılır.
Av hayvanını bulup avlamak üzere arama eylemi aynı alana bağlıdır.
Avcının sıcak zeminde hayvan beklerken ayağını korumak için giydiği çorap adlandırılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi karşılıklı yarışma, övünerek boy ölçüşme ve birbirine karşı koymayı aynı dalda birleştirir; kimsenin yarışamadığı kişi ifadesi de bu karşılaştırma eksenine dayanır. Geçici dal çerçevesi bu yapıyı doğru karşılar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal karşılıklı yarışma ve denk gelme alanındadır; yalnız aynı adı taşıma ya da genel üstünlük bu karşılıklılık olmadan dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Karşılıklı yarışma çekirdeği, övünerek boy ölçüşme, karşı koyma ve kimsenin yarışamaması bildiren özel biçimlerle karıştırılmadan verilir.

concept_map.definition: İki tarafın üstün gelmek için birbiriyle yarışması, övünerek boy ölçüşmesi veya birbirine karşı koymasıdır. Bir kimseyle hiç kimsenin yarışamaması, onun bu karşılaştırmada erişilemez üstünlüğünü bildirir.

facets.statement: İki veya daha çok taraf üstün gelmek için karşılıklı olarak yarışır.
Taraflar sahip oldukları üstünlüklerle övünerek birbirleriyle boy ölçüşür.
Taraflardan biri ötekine karşı koyar, onunla aynı düzeye gelmeye veya onu geçmeye çalışır.
Kimsenin bir kişiyle yarışamaması, o kişinin erişilemez ölçüde üstün olduğunu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar karşılıklı yarışma, övünerek boy ölçüşme ve karşı koyma anlamlarını birleştirir; bir kişiyle kimsenin yarışamaması ifadesini onun üstünlüğünün sonucu olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak cümlesi anlamı insanlar arasında yayılan ses ya da ünle sınırlar ve bunun yalnız iyi yönde olduğunu açıkça belirtir. Geçici dal tanımı yayılma, toplumsal alan ve olumlu değer koşullarını eksiksiz korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız insanlar arasında yayılan iyi ünü kapsar; kötü ün, her türlü ses veya dilsel ad bu sınıra girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, başka bir söz yapısından anlam taşımadan yalnız dalın insanlar arasında yayılan iyi ün çekirdeğini verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi hakkında insanlar arasında yayılan ve yalnız iyi yönde olan ün veya sözdür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi ya da hayvanı tanınmasını sağlayacak görünür bir izle işaretleme eylemini, bu eylemin bıraktığı izi ve işaretlemede kullanılan kızgın aracı birlikte verir. Sağlanan dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, her türlü soyut belirtiyi değil; yakma, kulak kesme veya çentikleme gibi yollarla bırakılan tanıtıcı fiziksel izi kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, ortak fiziksel işaretleme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; zırhın alt bölümündeki süslemeyi anlatan özel tamlama yalnızca kendi sözlüksel karşılığında korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi ya da hayvanı, tanınmasını veya ayırt edilmesini sağlayan kalıcı ve görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturacak biçimde işaretlemektir; iz yakma, kulak kesme ya da çentikleme yoluyla bırakılabilir. Anlam alanı, oluşan işareti ve özellikle hayvanı işaretlemeye yarayan kızgın aracı da kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesne veya hayvan üzerinde onu tanıtmaya ve başkalarından ayırmaya yarayan görünür bir fiziksel iz oluşturulur.
İşaret, kızgın araçla yakılarak, kulağın bir bölümü kesilerek veya çentik açılarak bırakılabilir.
Eylemin sonucunda kalan tanıtıcı iz de aynı anlam alanında adlandırılır.
Özellikle hayvanlara bu izi koymak için kullanılan kızgın işaretleme aracı da bu dala bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatımda temel ilişki, tanınacak şey üzerinde kasıtlı ve kalıcı bir iz oluşturma ilişkisidir. Yakma, kulak kesme ve çentikleme bu işlemin yollarıdır; sonuçtaki iz ile onu koyan kızgın araç da anlam alanına dahildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişide görülen belirtiyi okuyarak iyilik, kötülük veya genel durum hakkında sonuç çıkarma eylemini açıkça anlatır. Dal çerçevesindeki bakma, belirti ve çıkarım ilişkisi bu anlamı doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Burada belirtiyi yalnızca görmek yetmez; görünür izden kişinin niteliği veya durumu hakkında çıkarım yapılması gerekir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, kişideki belirtiyi yorumlama çekirdeğini verir; iyilik veya kötülükle kurulan özel yapılar bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişide görülen belirti veya izlere dikkatle bakarak onun iyiliği, kötülüğü, niteliği ya da durumu hakkında sezgisel bir sonuca varmaktır. Anlam, belirtinin kendisinden çok onu okuyup görünmeyen bir niteliği çıkarma eylemine dayanır.

facets.statement: Kişide görülen bir belirti, görünmeyen bir nitelik veya durumun göstergesi olarak okunur.
Gözlemden hareketle sezgisel bir değerlendirme ve çıkarım yapılır.
Çıkarılan nitelik iyilik de kötülük de olabilir; anlam yalnızca olumlu bir yargıyla sınırlı değildir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, kişideki görünür bir izin onun iyiliğine, kötülüğüne veya durumuna işaret ettiğini fark etmek ve bu işaretten sezgisel bir sonuç çıkarmaktır. Bakan kişi, belirtiyi anlam taşıyan bir gösterge olarak değerlendirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişideki görünür işaretten onun görünmeyen niteliği hakkında çıkarım yapma çekirdeğinin tamamında kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Belirtiyi gözlemleme, onu gösterge sayma ve kişilik ya da durum hakkında sonuç çıkarma aşamalarını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Görünür belirtilerin okunması ve bunlardan bir kişinin durumu hakkında sonuç çıkarılması vurgulandığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Gözlenen belirtileri anlamlı göstergeler olarak yorumlama ve sonuç çıkarma sürecini korur.
error_profile.adds: Tek başına kullanıldığında kişi dışındaki nesne ve olaylardan yapılan çıkarımları da kapsayabilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişideki belirtilerden onun iyiliği, kötülüğü veya genel niteliği hakkında hızlı bir yargıya varıldığında doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Açıkça söylenmeyen bir niteliğe dolaylı yoldan ulaşma sonucunu korur.
error_profile.adds: Görünür bir belirtiye dayanmayan içgüdüsel tahminleri de kapsayabilir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir kimsede iyilik ya da kötülük belirtisi görüp niteliğini sezmek
duruma işaret eden belirtileri okuyup sonuç çıkaranlar
üzerinde iyilik ya da kötülük belirtisi bulunan

error_profile.preserves: Kesin olmayan bir sonuca varma yönünü korur.
error_profile.adds: Herhangi bir görünür belirtiye veya kişiye dayanmayan bütün kestirimleri kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Genel olasılık hesabı ve gelecek öngörüsü anlamlarıyla karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişide iyiliğin yanı sıra kötülük veya başka bir durum belirtisini okuyup çıkarım yapmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir kişide görülen belirtilerden onun iyiliği hakkında sezgisel sonuç çıkarılır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal olumlu niteliği sezmekle sınırlıdır; odak dal ise olumlu veya olumsuz işaretleri okuyabilen daha geniş, fakat yine kişiye bağlı bir çıkarım alanıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Görünür belirtiden kişinin karakteri veya durumu hakkında sezgisel çıkarım yapmayı merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tanıma, karşılıklı tanışma, bir şeyi bildirme ve haber araştırma gibi geniş bilgi edinme işlemlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir iz veya gösterge, kişi ya da şey hakkında bilgi edinmeye yardım eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, belirtinin yorumlanmasıyla görünmeyen niteliğe ulaşır; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise daha genel tanıma ve bilinir kılma işlemleridir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Belirtiyi okuyanın kişilik veya durum hakkında sezgisel yargıya varmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yola yöneltme dahil olmak üzere bir şeyi bildiren her türlü göstergeyi ve gösterme ilişkisini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisinde de görünür bir belirti, doğrudan görünmeyen başka bir şeye ulaşmayı sağlar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal psikolojik bir okuma ve çıkarım eylemidir; komşu dal ise göstergenin bilgi verme işlevini genel olarak adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü değerlendirildi; olumlu nitelik sezme, izden tanıma ve genel gösterge ilişkileri okurun karıştırabileceği üç ayrı sınırı gösterdiği için seçildi.
